headline: SILVER CRASHES TO 11-MONTH LOW AT $52.60 — Alphabet AI Capex Surge Hammers Industrial Demand Outlook
snippet: Silver hit an 11-month low near $52.60 on October 29 as Alphabet's upgraded AI infrastructure spending plans raised fresh concerns about industrial demand substitution away from the metal. Hawkish Fed expectations for a December rate hike compound the selling pressure, sending silver down over 2% on the session.

headline: AUSTRALIA BACKS $180M INTO ASTRON-ENERGY FUELS RARE EARTHS JV — Donald Mineral Sands Mine Targets 2028 Start
snippet: The Australian federal government committed $180 million to Astron's Donald mineral sands project in western Victoria, a joint venture with US uranium major Energy Fuels, bringing total committed funding to $360 million. Trace uranium recovered from ore will be processed at Energy Fuels' White Mesa Mill in Utah; mining is expected to start in 2028.

headline: GOLD TO TEST $3,900 BEFORE DEC FED HIKE — Sucden Financial Sees Silver Falling to $50 Before Year-End Rebound
snippet: Analysts at Sucden Financial predict gold will test support around $3,900 before the Federal Reserve's December policy meeting, with silver potentially dropping to $50 as two hawkish dissents in the October hold keep December tightening expectations alive. The firm forecasts a recovery to $4,200–$4,300 gold by mid-January 2027.

headline: CRITICAL METALS SEALS EUROPEAN LITHIUM DEAL — Court-Approved Acquisition Completes, Nasdaq Shares Begin November 6
snippet: Critical Metals Corp confirmed the final option scheme consideration terms for its acquisition of European Lithium, the last step after Western Australian Supreme Court approval on October 26. New Critical Metals shares begin trading on Nasdaq on November 6, completing one of the year's notable junior lithium consolidations.

headline: FIREFLY METALS OPENS NEW COPPER-GOLD SYSTEM AT MOUNT JOY — 22.5m AT 2.5% CuEq in Maiden Hole at Green Bay Project
snippet: FireFly Metals (ASX: FFM) discovered a new high-grade copper-gold system at the Mount Joy prospect adjacent to its 50.4Mt Green Bay Project in Newfoundland. The first hole returned 22.5m at 2.5% CuEq (1.9% Cu, 0.6 g/t Au), and a strong downhole EM conductor indicates the system extends at least 80m further at depth.

headline: COPPER HOLDS NEAR TWO-WEEK HIGHS AT $14,432/T — Yangshan Premium Hits Near 13-Year High as China Spot Supply Stays Tight
snippet: LME three-month copper held near two-week highs at $14,432/t as tight physical spot supply in China provided underlying support against a firmer US dollar. The Yangshan copper import premium climbed to a near 13-year high of $188/tonne, signalling sustained Chinese import appetite despite post-Fed dollar strength.

headline: MAMBA STARTS MAIDEN DRILL ON 20KM GOLD TREND IN WESTERN AUSTRALIA — 50 Holes Planned at Never-Tested Meeka East Corridor
snippet: Mamba Exploration (ASX: M24) commenced its first-ever drill test of a 20km gold corridor at Meeka East in Western Australia, planning up to 50 holes and 6,000 metres through mid-December 2026. The initial holes target the 7km 140 Foot Well zone, which has never previously been drill tested despite covering a prospective structural corridor.

headline: AUSTRALIAN GOLD AND COPPER MAPS 1.9KM GOLD ZONE AT BROWNS REEF — Historic Core Resampling Reveals Expanded NSW Footprint
snippet: Australian Gold and Copper (ASX: AGC) reported new gold intercepts across a 1.9km corridor at Browns Reef in New South Wales by resampling historical drill core, including a 3m interval at 2.0 g/t Au from 99m depth. The company says gold mineralisation now spans its entire South Cobar ground package, significantly expanding the project's scale.

headline: BOLD VENTURES HITS HIGH-GRADE GOLD AT TRAXXIN — Ontario Ring of Fire Exposure Adds Critical Minerals Upside
snippet: Bold Ventures (TSXV: BOL) reported high-grade gold results from its Traxxin channel sampling program in Ontario and provided an update on its Ring of Fire ground position near Thunder Bay. The project gives the company leverage to Ontario's critical minerals corridor, a region drawing increased government and strategic investor interest.

headline: TSX FALLS 1% AS GOLD MINERS AND TECH SHARES SLIDE — Precious Metals Sector Posts Biggest Loss as Silver Hits Low
snippet: Canada's TSX Composite fell 1% on October 29 with gold mining stocks as the lead sector drag, following silver's drop to an 11-month low and gold's continued struggle above $4,040. The selling reflected spillover from hawkish Fed positioning and broader precious metals weakness rather than any company-specific catalyst.

headline: GOLD-SILVER RATIO WIDENS TO 76 — Silver Posts 6.4% Weekly Loss, Worst Performer Among Precious Metals
snippet: The gold-to-silver ratio widened to approximately 76 this week as silver fell roughly 6.4%, its steepest weekly drop of Q4, against a much steadier gold. ISA Bullion's October 27 daily metals analysis shows silver struggling to hold above $54 support, a level now broken, while gold retains relative strength above $4,000.

headline: KARNANI: SILVER VOLATILITY 'EXTREMELY HIGH' — Gold Holds Stable While Copper and Platinum Fundamentally Weak
snippet: Analyst Chintan Karnani's October 26 Asian metals market update on GoldSeek flags silver volatility as "very high" with spot at $54.14, warning that erratic silver price action makes risk management difficult for junior miners with silver exposure. Gold is assessed as relatively stable, while copper and platinum face ongoing fundamental weakness.
